{{Quote|All wings, line up behind me!|Anakin Skywalker to his starfighters|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
[[File:Bantha_formation.png|thumb|right|250px|Shadow Squadron flying in bantha formation]]
'''Bantha formation''' was a single-file [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] formation, referring to the single-file line that the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] would force the beasts to travel in so that the [[Bantha/Legends|Banthas']] footprints would not divulge the number of the traveling party. While evading [[Neebray/Legends|Neebrays]] in the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ordered [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] to employ the formation, and the tactic was also used in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
